Cite observation IDs in citedObservationIds array. Should include both? Only IDs that we actually cite. We'll cite supporting evidence ID for the telemetry numbers. Also need to include limitation from contradicting. Probably include both IDs.

Headline: concise coaching headline, no provider names. From insight headline: "Rate rose without preserving power in the Work 2 candidate." Could keep that.

Explanation: describe what happened, using exact numbers from bundle: "Mean stroke rate rose from 28.4 to 29.8 spm while mean power fell from 165.5 to 157.3 W." Also mention that it's telemetry-only, pending video review. Use exact numbers.

Cue: one short coaching instruction. Could be "Hold power before adding strokes."

Drill: from bundle drill.instructions verbatim: "Repeat a short work segment at the current rate, then add one stroke per minute only while watts remain at or above the starting average."

SuccessCriterion: verbatim from drill.successCriterion: "Power remains at or above the starting average after the rate increase."

citedObservationIds: include "candidate-work-2-concept2" and maybe also "candidate-selection-manual" because limitation is from contradicting. The limitation field: use limitation from contradicting evidence: "No visual or causal technique claim can be made."

Return JSON only.

Check formatting: plain ASCII spaces. Ensure no extra fields.
